import Cycle61.Assembly.Unconditional

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace Cycle61Verification

theorem allDirichlet {q : ℕ} [NeZero q]
    (χ : _root_.DirichletCharacter ℂ q) {s : ℂ}
    (hs : (874861 / 1000000 : ℝ) < s.re)
    (hpole : ¬ (χ = 1 ∧ s = 1)) :
    _root_.DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s ≠ 0 := by
  exact dirichlet_nonzero_of_chosen_affine chosen_affine_input χ s hs hpole

theorem zeta {s : ℂ}
    (hs : (874861 / 1000000 : ℝ) < s.re) (hpole : s ≠ 1) :
    riemannZeta s ≠ 0 := by
  exact zeta_nonzero_off_pole_of_chosen_affine chosen_affine_input s hs hpole

theorem allHecke (χ : OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeFamily.Character) {s : ℂ}
    (hs : (874861 / 1000000 : ℝ) < s.re)
    (hpole : ¬ (χ.residue = 1 ∧ s = 1)) :
    OAI.SevenEighths.HeckeFamily.LFunction χ s ≠ 0 := by
  exact hecke_nonzero_of_chosen_affine chosen_affine_input χ s hs (by tauto)

/-- Mathlib's total zeta function also has a nonzero value at its pole. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace OAI.SevenEighths.Cycle61InitialMass
noncomputable section
open scoped Classical BigOperators SchwartzMap ContDiff
open Filter HeckeFamily CanonicalQuadraticSieve RayFourExpansion QuadraticInitialBound
open CenteredMomentCommonRadialData CenteredMomentAmplificationChildInput

variable (H : Subgroup (O⧸M)ˣ) (hH : RayOrthogonality.globalUnits M≤H)

/-- The paid retained main estimate, uniform in the actual moving source. -/
def GeometryAffineMainPaidSpec
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O))
    (W : ℝ→ℂ)(hW : Continuous W)(hWs : Function.support W⊆Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 2)
    (ηseed η₀ : Character)(mesh μ : ℝ)(T : Finset α)
    (S : Finset (ℕ×ℕ))(D : ℕ)(Cm Z : ℝ) : Prop :=
    ∀(hZ : 1<Z)(θ : T→RayQuotient.Characters M H)(w σ freq : T→ℝ)
      (hσ : ∀i,σ i∈Set.Icc (33/50:ℝ) (33/50))
      (bΦ : ℝ)(state : NaturalState Z 0 bΦ)(hη : state.character=ηseed)
      (p : Profiles (1/4) (9/4))(t X₁ X₂ : ℝ)(hX₁ : 0<X₁)(hX₂ : 0<X₂),
      (∀i,0≤w i) → (∀i,w i≤mesh) →
      (41/100:ℝ)≤length Z X₁ → (41/100:ℝ)≤length Z X₂ →
      length Z X₁≤(44/100:ℝ) → length Z X₂≤(44/100:ℝ) →
      (17/500:ℝ)≤∑i,w i → (∑i,w i)≤(1/25:ℝ) →
      length Z X₁+length Z X₂+Cycle61.Arithmetic.lambda*(∑i,w i)≤Cycle61.Arithmetic.B →
    ∀(Ψ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))(reflected : Bool)(key : ℤ×(Fin 5→ℤ))(firstHeight height : ℝ),
      0≤height → (∀i,|freq i|≤height) →
    ∀χ₀ : RayCharacter,
    let s:=affineInput M H hH η₀ θ W hW 1 2 (33/50) (33/50)
      (by norm_num) hWs w σ freq hσ state p (by norm_num) 1 t X₁ X₂ hX₁ hX₂
    let amp:=Cycle61.Arithmetic.amp (Cycle61.Arithmetic.cellUpper (Cycle61.Moment.originalCell (∑i,w i)))
    let primes:=CenteredMomentPrimePool.primePool M H Sbad (1/2) 1 (Z^amp)
    let control:=(p.control S)^2*geometryHighFactor reflected
      (geometrySupportConstant (Fintype.card T) 1 (1/4) (1/4)) key*(1+|firstHeight|+height)^D
    (56/(primes.card:ℝ))*((amplifierCap 2 0 1+6*amp)/(amp/2))*
      ‖geometryMainRetainedSum reflected s 1 1 Z 1 amp (μ/64) (μ/8) (9/4)
        firstHeight hZ key 1 (Real.logb Z (volume s))
        (fun q=>normPhase (coordinateBlock s 1 1 Ψ (Z^(1:ℝ)) Z (μ/64) q))‖≤
      Cm*control*Z^(-(7/60000000:ℝ))

/-- Assemble the checked literal low and high estimates with the complete
retained main contraction. The actual subset remains the Fourier carrier;
the ambient cardinality enters only the outside loss ledger. -/

def GeometryAffineMainPaidSpec
    (Sbad : Finset (Ideal O))
    (W : ℝ→ℂ)(hW : Continuous W)(hWs : Function.support W⊆Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 2)
    (ηseed η₀ : Character)(mesh μ : ℝ)(T : Finset α)
    (S : Finset (ℕ×ℕ))(D : ℕ)(Cm Z : ℝ) : Prop :=
    ∀(hZ : 1<Z)(θ : T→RayQuotient.Characters M H)(w σ freq : T→ℝ)
      (hσ : ∀i,σ i∈Set.Icc (33/50:ℝ) (33/50))
      (bΦ : ℝ)(state : NaturalState Z 0 bΦ)(hη : state.character=ηseed)
      (p : Profiles (1/4) (9/4))(t X₁ X₂ : ℝ)(hX₁ : 0<X₁)(hX₂ : 0<X₂),
      (∀i,0≤w i) → (∀i,w i≤mesh) →
      (41/100:ℝ)≤length Z X₁ → (41/100:ℝ)≤length Z X₂ →
      length Z X₁≤(44/100:ℝ) → length Z X₂≤(44/100:ℝ) →
      (17/500:ℝ)≤∑i,w i → (∑i,w i)≤(1/25:ℝ) →
      length Z X₁+length Z X₂+Cycle61.Arithmetic.lambda*(∑i,w i)≤Cycle61.Arithmetic.B →
    ∀(Ψ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ))(reflected : Bool)(key : ℤ×(Fin 5→ℤ))(firstHeight height : ℝ),
      0≤height → (∀i,|freq i|≤height) →
    ∀χ₀ : RayCharacter,
    let s:=affineInput M H hH η₀ θ W hW 1 2 (33/50) (33/50)
      (by norm_num) hWs w σ freq hσ state p (by norm_num) 1 t X₁ X₂ hX₁ hX₂
    let amp:=Cycle61.Arithmetic.amp (Cycle61.Arithmetic.cellUpper (Cycle61.Moment.originalCell (∑i,w i)))
    let primes:=CenteredMomentPrimePool.primePool M H Sbad (1/2) 1 (Z^amp)
    let control:=(p.control S)^2*geometryHighFactor reflected

    (56/(primes.card:ℝ))*((amplifierCap 2 0 1+6*amp)/(amp/2))*

        firstHeight hZ key 1 (Real.logb Z (volume s))
        (fun q=>normPhase (coordinateBlock s 1 1 Ψ (Z^(1:ℝ)) Z (μ/64) q))‖≤

/-- The fixed weighted-source geometry budget has only its exact paid error
family left to supply. All retained main and source identities are internal. -/
theorem actual_weighted_source_geometry_budget_of_error {D : Cycle25.Weighted.MomentData}
    (F : WeightedSourceData D)(εaffine mesh bΦ : ℝ)(hε : 0<εaffine)
    (hmesh : mesh<(902420521/120632400000:ℝ)/2)(hmesh0 : 0≤mesh)
    (hmeshμ : mesh≤geometryLossUnit 1 εaffine/8)
    (hmeshcap : mesh≤Cycle25.Energy.commonMesh 2 28 1 (geometryLossUnit 1 εaffine/8))
    (hbΦ : 2≤bΦ)(hβlo : 51/100≤HeckeZeroSupremum.beta)
    (hβhi : HeckeZeroSupremum.beta≤7/8) :
    let W:=fun x=>conj (F.W x)
    let hW : Continuous W:=(Complex.conjCLE.contDiff.comp (F.W.smooth ⊤)).continuous
    let hs : Function.support W⊆Set.Icc (1:ℝ) 2:=by
      intro x hx
      exact F.complex_support (by intro hz;exact hx (by change conj (F.W x)=0;rw [hz];simp))
    let η:=fixedSourcePrincipal F.S F.exclusions.prime
    (∀Ψ : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ),Function.support (Ψ:ℝ→ℂ)⊆Set.Icc (-1) (bΦ+1) →
      (∀x,0≤(Ψ x).re) →
      ∀T : Finset (Fin D.N),∃S : Finset (ℕ×ℕ),∃degree : ℕ,∃C : ℝ,0≤C ∧
        ∀ᶠZ : ℝ in atTop,1<Z ∧
          GeometryAffineErrorPaidSpec F.modulus ⊤ le_top F.S W hW hs Ψ η η mesh εaffine T S degree C Z) →
    ∃τ : ℝ,0<τ ∧ τ≤geometryLossUnit 1 εaffine/16 ∧
      SourceLiteralAffineGeometryBudget F bΦ mesh εaffine τ (geometryLossUnit 1 εaffine/64) := by
  intro W hW hs η herror
  obtain ⟨τ,hτ,hτcap,hmain⟩:=actual_weighted_source_main_paid F εaffine mesh bΦ hε
    hmesh hmesh0 hmeshμ hmeshcap hbΦ hβlo hβhi
  refine ⟨τ,hτ,hτcap,?_⟩
  exact literal_affine_geometry_budget_of_main_error F.modulus ⊤ le_top F.S F.exclusions.bad
    W hW hs η η (weighted_sourceFixedIdeal F) bΦ mesh εaffine τ hε hmesh hmain herror

/-- The exact weighted source satisfies the geometry budget from the original
main and error estimates, without an additional analytic hypothesis. -/

its Fourier cutoff must retain their actual slot cardinality. -/
theorem geometry_allocation_weight_card_scale :

    rw [←pow_add,Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]
  unfold geometryAllocationWeight
  dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · rw [hp]
    ring
  · simp

/-- A uniform estimate for the whole positive family also estimates each
ratio fiber. The two inner Mellin energies use H=1; any outer physical
height factor remains in E. -/
theorem second_normalized_bound_of_full (W : 𝓢(ℝ,ℂ)) (degree windowDegree : ℕ)
    (d : Label→SecondInputDatum α)(w : Label→ℂ)(E : ℝ)
    (hfull : ∀(reflected : Bool)(t u : ℝ),
      secondNormalizedSum reflected d
        (secondEffectiveWeight (fun l=>(d l).block) w W) t u≤
      (E*(1+‖t‖)^degree)*(1+‖u‖)^(2*windowDegree)) :
    SecondNormalizedBound W degree windowDegree d w (fun _=>E) (fun _=>1) := by
  intro r _ reflected t u
  have hh:=(second_normalized_ratio_le W r reflected d w t u).trans (hfull reflected t u)
  simpa only [div_one,mul_one,ite_self] using hh

/-- Complete normalized energies control the retained block sum. Only the
number of ratio bins is paid; the source-label count never appears. -/
